gap: Space between the blocks inside. Ignored when **Lines** draws lines or cards; kept with **None** and **No lines, stacked on tablet**.
width: **Custom** with 50% makes one half of a two-column row.
custom_width: For two-column rows keep 50%, so the column line lines up with the sections above and below.
background_media: Leave on **None**. Tangent cells stay on the plain white page.
background_color: Leave empty. Colored boxes aren't part of the Tangent design.
toggle_overlay: Leave off. Only for a group with a background photo or video, which the site doesn't use.
border: Leave on **None**. Lines between cells come from **Lines** under **Tangent grid**.
border_radius: Leave at 0px: the Tangent design keeps square corners.
link: Makes the whole group a link. Inside a Tangent grid, a linked cell gets a soft background when the pointer is over it.
ts_grid: Draws thin lines between the blocks inside, in place of the gap. Each choice is explained under **Lines between cells** above.
ts_columns: Columns on screens 990px wide and up.
padding-block-start: Space inside the group. Inside the Tangent frame, values over 20px shrink smoothly on smaller screens.
padding-block-end: Space inside the group. Inside the Tangent frame, values over 20px shrink smoothly on smaller screens.
padding-inline-start: 48px is the usual cell padding. Inside the Tangent frame, values over 20px shrink smoothly on smaller screens.
padding-inline-end: 48px is the usual cell padding. Inside the Tangent frame, values over 20px shrink smoothly on smaller screens.
